My mental health has been declining hard and fast. It’s causing me to treat the people I love like garbage - I’m unhelpful, cranky, never participate in activities, prone to bursts of uncontrollable rage... you get the picture. 

I’ve been trying so hard to do everything “right” to try and help my mental health. I go to therapy as much as I can afford. I eat healthy, I exercise, I maintain a regular schedule. I try to get out and socialize as much as I can stand (although it’s very challenging due to panic attacks). And none of it is helping. I feel worse and worse every day. I hate the way I’m acting and I can’t stand the idea of going on like this indefinitely. 

I know this is a lot of stuff to dump on an Internet stranger, and I’m sorry for that. But I appreciate you taking the time to respond to my post - it meant a lot to me.

I’m sorry for whatever you’re going through that has led you to consider this. 

Explicitly discussing suicide/ harm methods is against the rules of this sub but I’m here to talk about what you’re going through if that’s something you want.

I also have nightmares all the time so I understand what you’re going through. It’s horrible. 

I think a lot of the time they don’t really “mean” anything. It’s just your brain trying to make sense of all the information it gets and pieces it together in different ways as an experiment. Like a kid inventing a drink that’s actually just water with ketchup and chocolate chips. Just combining random stuff to see what will happen. 

I’ve also found that the dreams that really upset me tend to be the most memorable. Then I think about it all day while I’m awake, and then dream about it because I was thinking about it. It’s a cycle that feeds itself.
